content.thinking: The end replacement removed the call site too — `s[end:]` starts at "    for r in roots:\n        assign(r, 10)" so the new text needs to include it. Let me fix by renaming call to `place` and re-adding the loop.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
s = open('refmodel.py').read()
s = s.replace("    for r in roots:\n        assign(r, 10)", "    for r in roots:\n        place(r, 10)")
open('refmodel.py','w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "place(r, 10)\|def place\|def descend\|assign" /workspace/tmp/refmodel.py | head
cd /workspace && timeout 1800 python3 tmp/fuzz.py 1 25
